user.title: Legrand UPS (CS121)
user.description: Connect to the Generex CS121 network adapter. Choose how to talk to it: SNMP (broad telemetry) or Modbus TCP (also exposes the UPS alarm flags such as Input bad).

snmp.title: SNMP settings
snmp.description: SNMP v2c on UDP port 161 by default.

modbus.title: Modbus settings
modbus.description: Modbus TCP on port 502 by default. The CS121 normally answers on unit ID 1.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to reach the device. Check the host, port, and (SNMP) community or (Modbus) unit ID.
error.invalid_response: The device responded but did not return the expected data.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.
